name: Wandering Trader Announcements
summary: Sends the chat message 'A wandering trader has arrived nearby!' to players within 64 blocks (horizontal distance) of a wandering trader.

mechanics.title: Detection
mechanics.description: Every second the pack finds wandering traders it has not yet announced, tags them, and messages all players within 64 blocks horizontally. Each trader is announced once.

qol: You will not miss a wandering trader.
getting_started: Nothing to do; watch for the gold chat message.
editor_notes: Fires for any untagged wandering trader that loads in, not only newly spawned ones.
